content: Deus Mo Rechokwe Yesa Duwler Bo Lol
Ikekapta mekla ye katos; Kristus mele ye lamliyey ngo ite kachepar. Luluwal le yai le Espritu Santus ye lamli ila ye hatugulu ngalyey le ite kachepar.
Ifa lepal tayikofel lal depey ngo ifa lepal yal tayug bbaregel lal depey
irel meka layi le ir spegil cchay! Iwe ngo ihable le yebe bidah riya la Deus yebe fang uwoay ngo ichuy tang Kristus le yagilir.

Ir lol Deus le re dduwel. Ye forur bo lol bo rebe dabey luwul falmay la yal. Yesa fang ngalir bogtag kala yal ngo ye fang ngalir Hatobtob we ir rebe kekasrowu le ye fel. Iwe ngo ye yoh ngalir mokwe Deus yesa hatugulu bo yebe fang;
Ir re chapdoh mo irer patriyarka kowe. Iwe ngo Kristus, irel yal mel le iy semal yarmat, ila wol iy semal chol daola yar. Sibe hapingpinga Deus le ye lamli pangal formel, pangal yadol! Amen.
Ite sosor le molwe Deus yesa hatugulu ila ye tay mmal; bo te panger yarmetael Israel ngo Deus yesa duweler bo lol.
Iwe ngo te wol panger choal daola yael Abraham ngo ir lol Deus. Deus ye kangalu Abraham bo, “Chol daola yael Isaac mele rebe pangir bo lom.”
Fael mele ila mekla lol Abraham le re subul wol yarmat, ila te panger ngo ir lol Deus: bo rechokla re sub le fael molwe Deus ye hatugulu mele ir kattosol chol daola yael Abraham.
Bo mala Deus ye hatugulu ila iye sengal yal sor: “Bela hola yodla ibe tefaeldoh, iwe ngo bele yor lol Sarah mal.”
Ngo te wol ila chog bo Rebecca iwe rumal lol mal, ngo semal chog temer, Isaac, we yach chapdoh.

Iwe ngo Deus mele ye duwley semal mokwe lol le yebe taboloh chog mekla iy Deus ye dipli; ila fal le Deus ye kangalu bo, “Mala mol yarmat mele yebe yengang ngal mala miril yarmat.” Ye sor mele mo imol molwe rebe sub, imol mala rebe foru sew formel le ye momay hare ye tayikof; ila yael Deus dduwel ila ye dduwel chog uwol mala iy ye dipli llufulyal, ngo te mil sew formel le ir re foru.
Iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Ihachangi Jacob ngo ihafobdiri Esau.”
Ila ngo meda mele sibe sor? Sibe sor bo Deus ila ye tayikof? Towe ila sengal!
Bo iy Deus ye kangalu Moses bo, “Yebe ffaho depey ngal le idipliy, iwe ngo ifahoy le idipli ibe fahoy.”
Mala ila te mil mekla yarmat re dipli hare mekla re foforu, bo mil ffahol ladep la yael Deus.
Bo babior we ye santus ye kangalu Pharaoh, “Isa forug bo king le fael mala hobe kawraloh mele kkeley, ngo ho foru bo yebe ffos idey lal balel faileng le.”
Ila Deus ye ffaho depal ngalir rechokla ye dipli yebe ffaho depal ngalir, iwe ngo ye forur rebe chiyemmay rechokla ye dipli yebe chiyemmay.
Yael Deus Ssong Mo Ffahol Ladep
Ila, semal hami le yebe kasiy bo, “Hare tos mele, ila ngo be ifa sengal ngo Deus ye sala wiri derer yarmat? Ila ngo itey le be yoh ngali le yebe happaliyel ngal mala depel Deus?”
Ngo gel itey ho maryarey le hobe la happaliyel ngal Deus? Tor sew rume le yema kasiya yeramtala ye foru bo, “Meda mele hola foruyey bo yebe iye sengay iyang?”

Bo yeramtala yema faor rume kala ila yor kkelal le yebe foru bol la ngal mele iy ye dipli, iwe ngo be yoh le yebe foru ruwow rume mo irel chog bol la bo sew mil chog ka sew yad, ngo ila sew mil yal be teptap seral mo seral.

Ila sengal mala Deus yesa foru. Ye memeal bo yebe kawraloh ssong la yal ngo ye hallehaloh lepal mala kkelal. Iwe ngo ye halellayiloh repiyal irer rechokla ye ssong ngalir le rechokwe yesa fel chog bo yebe limeserloh.
Ngo ye wol dipli le yebe kawraloh pallengel falmay la yal ngalir rechokla ye ffaho depal ngalir, le rechokla yesa hafler bo yebe yoh ngalir falmay la yal.
Bo gich mele yesa ffesang gich le te fofos chog mo luwullur Jews, bo ye wol fofos yarmat mo luwullur Gentiles.
Iye sengal molwe ye sor mo lal babior we yael Hosea,

content.text: “Rechoka te yusuwey ila ibele ffesangur bo, ‘Layi yarmat’.
Fuluwe ite hachangi ila ibele ffesangu bo, ‘Yai hachangcheng’.
Iwe ngo irel lobowe chog ye kangalur bo, ‘Te hami layi yarmat’, mele yebe ffesangur bo ir lol Deus le yema fang molow.”

content: Ngo Isaiah ye hamdefa kofael Israel we ye sor bo, “Ila mwo re cholop yarmetal Israel le rebe wochog lepal cholopal piy, ngo fedmal chog ir mele rebe daor.
Bo yebe tir yael Samol hatugulu kofer panger retalop.”
Ye wochog molwe Isaiah yesa mol sor metamo bo, “Hare ye wochog bo Samol yete itol fedmal chol daole yach, ila ngo gich sibe wochog Sodom, ngo si wochog Gomorrah.”
Israel Mo Ebangelium We
Ila ngo meda mele sibe sor? Sibe sor bo Gentiles kowe rete luluwaley bo rebe fel mo irel Deus, ila resa fel mo irel le fael yar tugulul ladep;
Iwe ngo rechokwe Deus yesa duwler ila re chil memeri sew hatobtob le yebe hafler mo irel Deus, iwe ngo re tuwiri.
Meda fal? Fael mala rete yetedah deper wol tugulul ladep, bo re yetedah chog deper wol mekla resa foru le ye fel. Ila fal le re cheprag irel “feas we hacchepragel yarmat,”
we babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Kalloh, iy sa itol sew feas wol Zion
sew feas le rebe cheprag iyang.
Iwe ngo semal le yor tugulul lal depal irel,
ngo tor mele yebe tayikof depal iyang.”
